meta.name: Magneta — grant sentinel pauser on unichain
meta.description: Register the Sentinelle circuit-breaker address 0x46D838E6C269c458c8017CC04C8015CbAf78DB8a as a pauser on the MagnetaGateway at 0xFf08089D777fe9506a245F0Bada18e1ec0382f3E. The breaker trips only on three deterministic conditions (owner is no longer the Safe, a registered module falls outside the signed manifest, or a watched contract's runtime bytecode changes) and can call nothing but pause(). Blast radius is bounded by the contract itself: pause() is open to a pauser but unpause() is onlyOwner, so a stolen breaker key can only halt the protocol — never reopen it, never move funds. Revoke at any time with removePauser.
